name: bga-sharedcode
description: Shared BGA framework stubs and tooling

scripts.lint:php: git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard '*.php' | xargs -0 php8.4 -l && echo 'All PHP files OK'
scripts.precommit: npm run lint:php && npm run smoke && npm run sync:check
